description: Kotlin repo: 9 detekt findings with the project's own detekt config, one duplicated function, a Gradle Kotlin script

notes.detekt config: config/detekt/detekt.yml lowers LongParameterList's functionThreshold to 4 (describe has 4 parameters, total 5; detekt's default 6 would flag neither) and adds 10, 18, 20, 65 and 80 to MagicNumber's ignoreNumbers, so only 10000 (line 6) and 5000 (line 8) are reported: the project's own config is honoured
notes.PricingTest.kt: no findings: detekt's default config excludes **/test/** from MagicNumber (20000, 2000)

notes.src/main/kotlin/com/acme/Names.kt#cognit: if+1, &&+1, when+1, if-expression+1 and its else+1 = 5
